Note: Digitisation: the markers of this figure were pixel-digitised from the embedded page bitmap (1950 x 3000 px, 8-bit grey) by Huttenlocher__1979_Figures3-6_extract.py (conda env 'python'; pymupdf, numpy, scipy), run 2026-10-31; a second run reports 'snapshot unchanged'. Open markers are located as the white region each outline encloses; filled markers by eroding the dark mask with a disk, which removes the fitted curve and the error bars. For this figure the two methods were cross-validated: matched-filter detection with a circle template and the erosion method return the SAME 22 markers to within 1 px. ESTIMATED ERROR +/- 0.2 x 10^8 synapses/mm3: the mean of the eight brains aged 16-72 y digitises to 11.00 x 10^8 against the 11 x 10^8 the text prints (p. 201). POINTS CONTAINED vs RESOLVED: the figure contains 22 plotted points and all 22 were individually resolved; none was inferred and none was obscured. The paper prints no count, so 22 is what the detectors agree on, not a printed total. Cross-check: the 12 of these brains aged <= 32 y are the 12 points Feinberg et al. (1990) replot in their Fig. 1(a) (N = 12, their Table 2); the two digitisations agree to a mean of 0.08 and a maximum of 0.16 x 10^8 synapses/mm3.
